paper_title: Hierarchical Catalogue Generation for Literature Review A Benchmark

model_annotation: The pie chart depicts the distribution of item numbers across hierarchical catalogue levels, showing three slices (categories) labeled around the chart as “Level1 - 8.2,” “Level2 - 12.1,” and “Level3 - 7.0.” The Level2 slice is colored medium light blue and occupies approximately 44.32% (percentage shown inside the slice), the Level1 slice is a very pale blue at about 30.04%, and the Level3 slice is a darker blue at about 25.64%. Percentage labels are printed inside each wedge, there is no separate legend, and the slices are separated by thick white boundaries without any exploded or offset emphasis; visually, the largest segment (Level2) appears on the left, with the other two segments on the upper-right (Level1) and lower-right (Level3).
